title: Godot editor crashes when quitting a XR project on MacOS
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7-beta1, [`master`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/a0375dde960ee9dba46d461e0145123609691950) on MacOS
- ~Not reproducible in 4.6.2~ Reproducible in 4.6.2

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - macOS Tahoe (26.3.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M3 Pro - Apple M3 Pro (11 threads) - 36.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The Godot editor v4.7-beta1 crashes when quitting or restarting a XR project.

### Steps to reproduce

- Download a XR project (e.g: https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3386)
- Launch Godot editor 4.7-beta1 and edit the XR project
- From within the editor, select `Quit to Project List`
- Notice that the editor crashes and the Project Manager doesn't show

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

See repro steps above using https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3386
